in_sanskrit.name: हालिश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: हाल (Hal) means 'God' or 'Lord' in Sanskrit, and इश (Ish) means 'Lord of'. Therefore, Halesh could be interpreted as 'Lord of God' or 'God of Lords'.
